exposure: GDM care pathway redesign (shifting activities from Internal Medicine Department to Integrated Maternity Care Organization)
outcome: referrals to Internal Medicine Department for GDM
cohort: Women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) in 2021 (pre-intervention cohort, N=264) and 2022 (post-intervention cohort, N=407).
finding: The redesign of GDM care positively impacted value through decreased referrals to IMD, improved patient-reported experiences, and realized cost savings, while maternal and neonatal clinical outcomes remained unchanged.
